web.teacher_login.description: Teacher sign-in with an animated Cues companion; uses existing Supabase teacher accounts.

web.teacher_signup.description: Teacher sign-up at /signup with the Cues companion; creates a Supabase account.

web.alert_phone.description: Optional sign-up step that saves the teacher's mobile number (user metadata alert_phone) for Photon alerts.

web.dashboard.description: Read-only teacher dashboard with Supabase seats and realtime state updates.

web.landing.description: Public landing page at /; the teacher dashboard moves to /dashboard.

vision.supabase_events.description: Send vision events and seat_state to Supabase. When off, they are written only to vision/logs/*.jsonl.

vision.hands.description: MediaPipe hand tracking, with each hand assigned to a seat.

vision.faces.description: MediaPipe face detection and the face crop per seat.

vision.gestures.description: Gesture match score per seat against the teacher's recorded examples.

vision.expression.description: HSEmotion facial-expression context per seat (supporting evidence only).

vision.raise_hand.description: Raise-hand rule per seat: a wrist above that seat's face, held briefly.

vision.task_status.description: Per-seat task status and events (attempt_success, attempt_miss, review_needed, no_progress, tracking_lost, expression_context).

vision.activity_sync.description: Read the current task from Supabase sessions.current_activity_id instead of CUES_TASK.

web.teacher_reviews.description: Pending TeacherReview requests via Supabase. On the dashboard they are pinned first in the Class list as Needs you (even when the person is out of view), with the agent's rationale behind "Why did Cues ask?". Off: no requests and no rationale are read or shown.

web.teacher_review_actions.description: Persistent review decisions through the resolve_teacher_review RPC (migrations 003-017, applied)

web.session_controls.description: Authenticated station session lifecycle and activity controls

web.person_observations.description: Read tracking_valid and show fresh, invalid, lost and paused person observations

vision.session_lifecycle.description: Follow teacher-managed station sessions, pin frame IDs and pause task processing on session end or sync loss

vision.all_scores.description: Display-only readout of every task's score for every person (overlay and vision.watch). Not sent to Supabase.

vision.custom_gestures.description: Dashboard API to create teacher-recorded gestures (/gestures). Definitions and examples stay in vision/templates/ on this laptop.

web.landing_faq.description: FAQ section and the full site footer on the landing page. When off, the landing page keeps its one-line footer.

web.teacher_profile.description: Save the signed-in teacher's display name and E.164 phone number to teacher_profiles (migration 006), and move the sign-up number there after first sign-in.

web.landing_demo.description: Landing hero shows a looping demo of the real dashboard (banner, People rows, review rows) with simulated students. When off, the hero keeps the older preview card.

web.landing_motion.description: Landing page sections fade in once as they scroll into view. When off, every section is visible from the start.

web.theme_toggle.description: Light/dark switch on the landing page, log-in, sign-up and the dashboard. The choice is saved in the browser. When off, each page keeps its default: Night for the landing page and dashboard, white for log-in and sign-up.

vision.station_config.description: Local /config endpoint: the signed-in teacher's dashboard sets this laptop's station. Vision writes nothing until a station is set. When off, the station is S1 (or CUES_STATION_ID) as before.

web.vision_station_config.description: Dashboard sends the signed-in teacher's station to the vision service on 127.0.0.1:8000/config. When off, nothing is sent.

agent.live_progress.description: Publish guarded live progress summaries after migration 012 deploys.

web.live_progress.description: Read agent-owned evaluated progress from seat_state after migration 012.

vision.flag_on_time_on_task.description: Flag a child as needing review after the no-progress wait of plain time on task (tracking loss excluded), even when Cues could not score their hand. Off: only judged time counts (PR #101).

vision.review_marks.description: Read the teacher's Mark as reviewed marks so a flagged child goes back to working and the no-progress timer restarts. Reads only seat ids and times from Supabase.

web.review_page.description: To review page at /review: each person Cues asked about as a card with the activity, time, Support needed / No support needed, Mark as reviewed and "Why did Cues ask?". Adds a To review link to the rail and the classroom header. Off: /review redirects to /dashboard and no links show.

web.review_waiting.description: To review also lists each person the camera flagged (Needs Review) who has no request from Cues yet, as "No suggestion yet" with Mark as reviewed, and counts them on the To review link; the classroom Attention panel names them instead of saying All clear (or under the requests). Nothing is written for them. Off: To review and Attention cover only Cues's requests.

web.health_strip.description: Camera health strip on the classroom page: camera service on or off, station set, updates arriving, and another camera refused, each as its own word. Reads the local vision service on 127.0.0.1:8000 (/health, /config) and the station's writer row. Off: the page shows only its single camera-off message.

agent.interventions.description: The agent may attach one suggested support from the approved intervention menu to a review request. Needs migration 018; the teacher approves before anything is recorded.

web.interventions.description: Show the agent's suggested support on a review and let the teacher approve it (or pick another from the menu). Needs migration 018; approving also confirms the review.

web.hosted_local_feed.description: Allow the configured hosted dashboard origin to connect directly to local vision; local-network permission and explicit backend CORS required.

web.reset_people.description: Switching or restarting the activity puts everyone back to working: the refresh button beside Start/End restarts the current activity (finished and flagged people start over) and the requests still open are closed. Off: the button only reloads the session and switching leaves open requests alone.

web.landing_needs.description: Landing page: the section "Made for special education (SEN) classrooms" (three cards in the privacy section's style) replaces "The camera stays in the classroom", plus two FAQ answers (SEN, workload). The privacy answers stay in the FAQ. Off: the page is as before.

web.companion.description: The Cues companion perches on the To review pill: blue at rest, orange (with a hop) when a request is waiting, and when the queue clears it eats the count and turns green before resting. Decoration only; never a student. Off: the pill shows its text and count alone.
